entries.text: Whoever rebels against the laws of the land shall be put to death.

text.text: Whosoever he be that doth rebel against thy commandment, and will not hearken unto thy words in all that thou commandest him, he shall be put to death: only be strong and of a good courage.

entries.text: The man that acts presumptuously by not listening to the priest or the judges, that man shall die.

text.text: And the man that will do presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest that standeth to minister there before the Lord thy God, or unto the judge, even that man shall die: and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel.

entries.text: Rebellion and insurrection against the government is punishable by death.

text.text: And there happened to be there a man of Belial, whose name was Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he blew a trumpet, and said, We have no part in David, neither have we inheritance in the son of Jesse: every man to his tents, O Israel.
So every man of Israel went up from after David, and followed Sheba the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah clave unto their king, from Jordan even to Jerusalem.

And David came to his house at Jerusalem; and the king took the ten women his concubines, whom he had left to keep the house, and put them in ward, and fed them, but went not in unto them. So they were shut up unto the day of their death, living in widowhood.
Then said the king to Amasa, Assemble me the men of Judah within three days, and be thou here present.
So Amasa went to assemble the men of Judah: but he tarried longer than the set time which he had appointed him.
And David said to Abishai, Now shall Sheba the son of Bichri do us more harm than did Absalom: take thou thy lord’s servants, and pursue after him, lest he get him fenced cities, and escape us.
And there went out after him Joab’s men, and the Cherethites, and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men: and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue after Sheba the son of Bichri.

When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa went before them. And Joab’s garment that he had put on was girded unto him, and upon it a girdle with a sword fastened upon his loins in the sheath thereof; and as he went forth it fell out.
And Joab said to Amasa, Art thou in health, my brother? And Joab took Amasa by the beard with the right hand to kiss him.

But Amasa took no heed to the sword that was in Joab’s hand: so he smote him therewith in the fifth rib, and shed out his bowels to the ground, and struck him not again; and he died. So Joab and Abishai his brother pursued after Sheba the son of Bichri.
And one of Joab’s men stood by him, and said, He that favoureth Joab, and he that is for David, let him go after Joab.

And Amasa wallowed in blood in the midst of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people stood still, he removed Amasa out of the highway into the field, and cast a cloth upon him, when he saw that every one that came by him stood still.

caseRefs.name: Absalom
caseRefs.charge: Murder of Amnon; conspiracy and rebellion against the king his father; lying with his father's concubines

caseRefs.name: Ahithophel
caseRefs.charge: Treason against David; counsel of incest; suicide

caseRefs.name: Sheba son of Bichri
caseRefs.charge: Insurrection: we have no part in David

caseRefs.charge: Insurrection: we have no part in David

caseRefs.name: Adonijah
caseRefs.charge: Exalting himself to be king; asking for the king's concubine

caseRefs.name: Zimri
caseRefs.charge: Conspiring against his master Elah as he drank himself drunk; slaying all the house of Baasha

caseRefs.name: Hazael king of Syria
caseRefs.charge: Smothering his master to take the throne, and doing to Israel the evil Elisha wept over

caseRefs.name: Athaliah
caseRefs.charge: Destroying the seed royal of Judah; usurping the throne

caseRefs.name: Jehoiada the priest
caseRefs.charge: Hiding the king's son six years from Athaliah; making a covenant between the Lord, the king, and the people; doing good in Israel, both toward God and toward his house

caseRefs.name: Bigthan and Teresh
caseRefs.charge: Conspiring to lay hands on king Ahasuerus

caseRefs.name: Tryphon
caseRefs.charge: Taking Jonathan the high priest by treachery under a covenant of friendship; slaying him and the young king Antiochus
